screening_decisions.reason: RCT of LAIV in elderly adults assessing influenza efficacy and immunogenicity. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events as outcomes.
RCT of influenza vaccination in elderly assessing influenza-like illness and serological influenza. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.
RCT of H5N1 prepandemic vaccine assessing immunogenicity and safety. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.

PROBE RCT of influenza vaccination vs no treatment in patients with acute coronary syndrome. Primary endpoint includes combined major cardiovascular events (death, hospitalization from ACS, heart failure, stroke). Meets all selection criteria.
RCT of H1N1 vaccines assessing immunogenicity and safety. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.
RCT of influenza vaccination in healthy elderly assessing influenza diagnosis and cost-effectiveness. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.
Substudy of FLUCAD RCT assessing antibody response to influenza vaccine in coronary artery disease patients. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events as outcomes.
Observational prospective study, not an RCT. Compares vaccinated vs unvaccinated cohorts without randomization.
RCT comparing intranasal vs intramuscular influenza vaccine formulations assessing immunogenicity and tolerability. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.
RCT comparing high-dose vs standard-dose influenza vaccine assessing safety, immunogenicity, and relative efficacy. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.
RCT of RSV vaccines given with influenza vaccine assessing immunogenicity and safety. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.
Controlled study of influenza vaccine effect on warfarin anticoagulation. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.
Before-after experimental study with control group, not an RCT. Assesses vaccination coverage, not cardiovascular outcomes.
Case-control study, not an RCT. Assesses association between influenza vaccination and stroke risk.
RCT of influenza vaccination vs control in myocardial infarction and PCI patients. Primary outcomes include cardiovascular death and composite cardiovascular endpoints. Meets all selection criteria.
Ecological/observational study comparing vaccination programmes across municipalities, not an RCT.
RCT of influenza vaccination in elderly assessing immune response and hospital admissions. Does not specifically assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.

RCT of influenza vaccination in patients on vitamin K antagonists assessing INR values and hemorrhagic/thrombotic events. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events as primary outcomes.
RCT of FluMist safety in seniors with chronic conditions assessing safety and tolerability. Does not assess cardiovascular death or cardiovascular events.
Methodology paper on meta-analysis, not an RCT or primary research study.

This is an RCT of influenza vaccine vs placebo in healthy adults, but the outcomes assessed are immunogenicity (antibody titers, IgA) and influenza illness incidence. No cardiovascular outcomes (cardiovascular death or non-fatal cardiovascular events) are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT comparing one vs two doses of influenza vaccine in patients with haematological malignancies. The outcomes are immune response (antibody seroconversion rates). No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is a review article discussing the biologic basis and epidemiologic evidence for a causal relationship between influenza and cardiovascular disease using Bradford Hill's criteria. It is not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet the study design criterion.

This is an RCT comparing AS03-adjuvanted vs non-adjuvanted influenza vaccine in elderly people. The outcomes are influenza infection rates (PCR-confirmed). No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT comparing concomitant vs sequential administration of Tdap and influenza vaccine. Outcomes are safety (adverse events) and immunogenicity (seroprotection rates). No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT comparing split-virion vs subunit influenza vaccines. Outcomes are safety, reactogenicity, and immunogenicity (antibody titers). No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT of LAIV vs placebo in healthy working adults. Outcomes are febrile illness, work loss, and health care use. No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT comparing inactivated vs live attenuated influenza vaccines vs placebo in healthy adults. Outcomes are laboratory-confirmed influenza illness. No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT comparing cell culture-derived vs egg-based influenza vaccines. Outcomes are safety, reactogenicity, and immunogenicity. No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT (crossover design) assessing oculorespiratory syndrome and other symptoms after influenza vaccine vs placebo. Outcomes are vaccine-attributable symptoms. No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT assessing safety and immunogenicity of TIV in adults previously given pandemic vaccine. Outcomes are adverse events and antibody titers. No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.
This is an RCT evaluating concomitant administration of PCV13 and TIV. Outcomes are immunogenicity and safety. No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.
This is an RCT of H1N1 vaccine in various age groups. Outcomes are safety and immunogenicity (antibody titers). No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.

This is an RCT comparing concomitant vs sequential administration of Tdap-IPV and influenza vaccine in elderly. Outcomes are immunogenicity and safety. No cardiovascular outcomes are assessed. Does not meet the outcome criterion.
This is a CDC/ACIP recommendations document providing guidance on influenza vaccination. It is not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet the study design criterion.
This is a CDC/ACIP recommendations document providing guidance on influenza vaccination. It is not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet the study design criterion.

This is a review/commentary article discussing the association between influenza and coronary artery disease, referencing other studies including RCTs and a meta-analysis. It is not itself a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet the study design criterion.

This is a meta-analysis pooling data from 5 trials examining influenza vaccination and cardiovascular outcomes. While it addresses relevant outcomes, it is not a primary randomised controlled trial. Does not meet the study design criterion.

This is a modeling/projection study of global mortality and burden of disease. It is not an RCT of influenza vaccination, and does not assess cardiovascular outcomes related to influenza vaccination. Does not meet the study design, intervention, or outcome criteria.

This is a case-control study examining the association between influenza vaccination and recurrent MI in CHD patients. While it addresses relevant outcomes (myocardial infarction), it is not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet the study design criterion.

Cohort study, not an RCT. Methods describe cohorts studied during two influenza seasons with multivariable logistic regression. While it assesses relevant cardiovascular outcomes (hospitalization for cardiac disease, cerebrovascular disease), it does not meet the RCT requirement.
Cohort study, not an RCT. Data pooled from 18 cohorts using logistic regression. No randomization to vaccination vs placebo/no treatment.
Review article, not an RCT. Summarizes available literature rather than presenting original trial data.
Commentary/discussion paper, not an RCT. Discusses existing evidence and proposes analytical framework rather than presenting new RCT data.
Case-control study, not an RCT. Cases identified from paramedic reports, controls via random digit dialing. No randomization to vaccination occurred.
Self-controlled case series study, not an RCT. Within-person comparisons used; no randomization to vaccination vs control.

Meta-analysis of RCTs directly addressing the review question. Included 5 published and 1 unpublished RCTs comparing influenza vaccine vs placebo/control in high-risk CVD patients, reporting cardiovascular outcomes (composite events, CV mortality, individual events). Provides synthesized RCT evidence relevant to the review.
Systematic review with meta-analysis of RCTs. Two small RCTs assessed protection against cardiac events in people with existing CVD. Provides relevant RCT evidence for the review question.
Time series observational study, not an RCT. Used Poisson regression models with surveillance data. No randomization to vaccination; examines associations between influenza circulation and MI.
Self-controlled case series study, not an RCT. Investigates AMI risks after acute respiratory infection consultation. No randomization to vaccination vs control.

While this IS an RCT in a cardiovascular population (heart transplant recipients), outcomes are NOT cardiovascular death or non-fatal CV events. Outcomes are endomyocardial biopsies for rejection and serologic studies. Focuses on vaccine safety regarding transplant rejection, not CV event prevention.
Abstract content does not match title - describes exercise programme for chronic fatigue syndrome in psychiatry department. Does not assess cardiovascular outcomes from influenza vaccination.

While this IS an RCT, outcomes are NOT cardiovascular death or non-fatal CV events. Outcomes are safety reactions and immunogenicity (GMTs, seroprotection, seroconversion). Does not assess cardiovascular outcomes.
Non-randomized controlled study, not an RCT. Explicitly states 'non-randomized, controlled, prospective methodology.' Outcome is influenza-like illness (ILI), not cardiovascular events.

While this IS an RCT in a cardiovascular population (heart failure patients), outcomes are NOT cardiovascular death or non-fatal CV events. Outcomes are antibody production by hemagglutination inhibition assay. Compares dosing strategies for immunogenicity, not CV event prevention.
Book chapter about search methodology, not a research study. Contains sections on search planning, strategies, reference management. No primary research data.
